units.name: Connect to Wi-Fi
units.purpose: Guide office staff in connecting to CorpNet with their current password
units.prerequisite_treatment: No separate prerequisite is supplied; link back to the /wifi overview for shared orientation
units.boundary_rationale: This section serves the distinct connection task and can be maintained independently

units.name: Reset a Wi-Fi password
units.purpose: Guide office staff through resetting their password and reconnecting to CorpNet
units.prerequisite_treatment: No separate prerequisite is supplied; link back to the /wifi overview and retain the confirmation warning with the reset procedure
units.boundary_rationale: Password reset, reconnection, verification, and the governed warning form one task boundary; the hard constraint keeps Reset and verify with Warning

shared_context: Retain Overview at /wifi as the overview for both tasks, with links to the two task units
duplicate_risks: Connecting to CorpNet and entering a password occurs in Connect to Wi-Fi, while reconnecting to CorpNet with the new password occurs in Reset a Wi-Fi password. Preserve the reset-specific reconnect step; use a cross-link to the connection unit if fuller connection instructions would otherwise be repeated.
migration_checklist: Draft separate task-unit proposals without rewriting source instructions
Keep Overview at /wifi and propose links from it to both task units
Keep Reset and verify and Warning together
Propose links from each task unit back to /wifi
Apply the supplied convention so any retired task URL redirects to /wifi
Have IT Support review ownership, boundaries, warnings, and proposed links
Review localization needs and link labels before any migration
Confirm every heading remains represented before publication
verification: Every supplied heading has exactly one placement
Overview is retained only in shared context and is absent from unit section lists
Reset and verify and Warning remain together
The reconnect action is identified across the affected task units
The supplied /wifi URL, redirect convention, audience, and owner are preserved
No rewrite or migration is claimed
open_decisions: Choose canonical URLs for the two task units
Confirm who performs final editorial review for IT Support
Choose link labels and routing between /wifi and the task units
